stem.text: Plant cells were put into one of three different concentrations of sugar solution, 10%, 5% and 2.5%.
The cells were left for 50 minutes and then observed using a light microscope.

stem.alt: Drawing of a plant cell outline with an inner membrane and an oval inside, labelled cell X and vacuole.
Drawing of a cell outline with an inner outline, labelled cell Y.
Drawing of a cell outline with an irregular inner shape and a small circle, labelled cell Z.

items: Cell Y had a lower water potential than the sugar solution it was put into.
Cell Z was put into the 10% sugar solution.
Cell Z had a less negative water potential than the sugar solution it was put into.
